title: ELVES Falath Pro Disc 2022 exact frame, geometry and technical page
notes: Corrected on 2026-08-30 from the rim-brake sibling page (id=91) to the exact Falath Pro Disc 2022 manufacturer page (id=93). The exact disc page specifies Toray T800 carbon with T1000 reinforcement at the head tube and bottom bracket, EPS molding, a 1,080 g size-46 frame, 398 g fork, BB86, flat-mount disc brakes, thru-axles, full internal routing, 28C maximum, and the official seven-size geometry graphic. Its stiffness claims are qualitative and contain no numeric magnitude or reproducible protocol.
